en.title: Codex edited then tested, tested then edited again—I only spotted the trap when I checked the Tokens
en.summary: Ask Codex to fix one small issue, and it cycles through edit, full test run, edit again. Half a day disappears, and your quota and patience hit bottom together. Worse: a pile of tests pass, but hitting run still throws an error. The author offers a set of guardrails you can drop straight into AGENTS.md. If you use Codex or Claude Code regularly and keep getting slowed down by these self-loops, it's worth adjusting your rules once and giving it a try.

items_all.title: 换到企业里，问题就变了。 谁能让 Agent 读哪些数据？Agent 改了东西，谁来复核？员工离职后，他配的那套 Agent 交接给谁？出了问题，能不能查到是哪一步做的决定？ 一个人用，靠自己盯着就行。几十个人一起用，这些都要事先设计好。

en.title: I also made a version of the "Sima Guang smashing the vat security footage." Ancient surveillance videos are really popular lately — a lot of fun. I made mine with MiniMax H3 (ComfyUI) on RunningHub. Steps: first create character and courtyard reference images, then generate the falling into the water, figuring out a plan, smashing the vat, and rescue as separate segments. For video generation, describe a fixed camera position.
